vbt.reason: Windows exposes no supported user-mode API that returns the VBT. The VBT lives in the IGD OpRegion (system memory at the address in PCI config register ASLS) or inside the GOP/firmware image; reading either needs physical-memory or PCI-config access, which is out of scope.

tried: ACPI DSDT/SSDT byte scan for IGDO/ASLS/ASLB/OPRG (P40)
opregion.reason: ACPI tables only declare the OperationRegion; its base address is a runtime value and its contents are in physical memory. Not read.

edp_link_parameters.reason: Lane count, link rate, PSR, backlight control and DPCD are not exposed by any supported read-only Windows API; EDID gives timings only.

ddi_port_mapping.reason: Connector enumeration lists driver-exposed targets and output technology, not DDI port numbers / AUX channels / physical routing (that data is in the VBT child-device table).
